title: Unlimited Free Trial Terms by Plan
content:
**Terms of Membership — Schedule T: Free Trials on Marlowe & Finch Unlimited**

T.1 The free trial offered on each Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan, and the terms that govern trial eligibility, are as set out in the table below. Trial lengths are counted in calendar days.

| Plan | Free trial length | Look-back for earlier memberships | Most trials per customer, ever | Card on file needed to start a trial | Trial converts into |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Standard Monthly | 30 calendar days | 12 calendar months | 1 | Yes | The same plan |
| Unlimited Student Annual | 0 days (no trial) | 12 calendar months | 1 | Yes | The same plan |
| Unlimited Standard Annual | 30 calendar days | 12 calendar months | 1 | Yes | The same plan |
| Unlimited Express Monthly | 30 calendar days | 12 calendar months | 1 | Yes | The same plan |
| Unlimited Express Annual | 30 calendar days | 12 calendar months | 1 | Yes | The same plan |
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual | 30 calendar days | 12 calendar months | 1 | Yes | The same plan |

T.2 The look-back is the number of calendar months before the enrollment date in which any Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership held by the customer removes eligibility for a trial.

T.3 The lifetime figure is the most trials one customer can ever receive across all Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plans.

T.4 On every plan, membership benefits begin on the enrollment date, whether or not a trial applies.

T.5 A trial plan "converts into the same plan": a trial taken on Unlimited Express Monthly converts into Unlimited Express Monthly, and so on for each plan.

**Notes to Schedule T**

- Unlimited Student Annual is the one plan with a trial length of 0 days; a membership on that plan opens with no free trial.
- A trial length of 0 days on the enrollment record shows a trial end date equal to the enrollment date.
- Illustration (hypothetical dates): a 30-day trial on a plan joined on a hypothetical 1 June ends 30 calendar days after the enrollment date, on 1 July, which the membership record shows as its trial end date.
